title: The full reconcile suite cannot fit one local run under the host-shared flags
description:
AGENTS.md prescribes GOTEST_PARALLEL=4 GOFLAGS=-p=2 for heavy local commands on this shared host, and at those flags a single-process `go test ./internal/reconcile/` blew both a 40m and a 55m -timeout with tests still backlogged (the two running tests at the 55m alarm had started 41s earlier). The only shape that fits locally is CI's sharding (.github/scripts/go-test-shard.sh): the three shards at the Makefile's own -parallel 12 took 914s/927s/670s. A worker following the instruction faithfully cannot produce the single-invocation full-suite pass the tick's acceptance names; worth either sharding `make test` for this package locally or documenting the shard command as the local full-suite invocation.
evidence: go test ./internal/reconcile/ -timeout 55m at GOTEST_PARALLEL=4 GOFLAGS=-p=2: `panic: test timed out after 55m0s` with TestARestartMidRepairFinishesTheRepairAndClosesTheTick/fresh_clone (41s) and TestARejectedAttemptWhoseBranchIsGoneButWhoseHeadIsIntegratedIsFinished/fresh_clone (41s) still running; both pass in shard 2 and shard 3 (914s/927s/670s, exit 0)

ticfac run epic-t8u filed this backlog tick from the finding 4d9214177db22c9dad45ddbe3b126ce19de7348b48336cd3151c74095e9324b8 (reported by run-epic-t8u/tick-krh/attempt-8) rather than absorb it into the running epic: it is not absorbed: only a finding the final reviewer names blocking, or a high-severity one whose reporter names the done item it breaks while the work is under way, enters the running epic. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-t8u/absorptions/4d9214177db22c9dad45ddbe3b126ce19de7348b48336cd3151c74095e9324b8.json on the run branch.
